source_text: Fides vestra annuntiatur in universo mundo. Non erubesco Evangelium: virtus enim Dei est in salutem omni credenti, Iudaeo primum et Graeco. Iustitia Dei revelatur ex fide in fidem — iustus ex fide vivit.
pass_a_gloss: Your faith is announced in the whole world. I am not ashamed of the Gospel: for it is the power of God unto salvation for everyone who believes, to the Jew first and to the Greek. The righteousness of God is revealed from faith to faith — the just lives from faith.
pass_b_english: [[Your faith is proclaimed in all the world >> Bible:Romans 1:8]]. [[I am not ashamed of the gospel, for it is the power of God for salvation >> Bible:Romans 1:16]] — Jew first, then Greek. [[The righteousness of God is revealed from faith to faith; the righteous shall live by faith >> Bible:Romans 1:17]].
notes: True OET; no Scheck FOTC Romans.
